alter table public.support_agents enable row level security;
alter table public.supervisors enable row level security;
alter table public.customers enable row level security;

create policy support_agents_select on public.support_agents
  for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy supervisors_select on public.supervisors
  for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy customers_select on public.customers
  for select to authenticated
  using (true);

create view public.support_customers
with (security_invoker = true) as
select
  c.id,
  c.region,
  c.full_name,
  case
    when c.email is null then null
    else left(c.email, 1) || '***'
       || substring(c.email, strpos(c.email, '@'))
  end as email_masked,
  case
    when c.phone is null then null
    else '******' || right(c.phone, 4)
  end as phone_masked
from public.customers c
join public.support_agents a on a.user_id = auth.uid()
where c.region = a.region;
